name: Citizenship by Naturalisation, Marriage Ground

requirements.blocker_text: At least 5 years of marital status maintained, evidenced by proof of shared marital life and an interview with the Rwandan spouse.
requirements.fix_path: Remain married for 5 years and maintain shared marital life.

sources.title: Directorate General of Immigration and Emigration (DGIE), Rwanda -- citizenship, marriage ground: 5 years of marital status to a Rwandan citizen, marriage certificate, proof of shared marital life, spousal interview

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Rwanda). STATUS: PUBLISHED -- fully tier-1 DGIE sourced. Gender-neutral: the source uses no gendered language distinguishing a foreign wife from a foreign husband of a Rwandan citizen. This is a genuinely SEPARATE named legal ground under the 2021 Organic Law (not a reduced-residence variant of the general naturalisation track, unlike Romania's or Slovakia's Article-8-style marriage clauses) -- Rwanda's marriage-based citizenship is its own standalone pathway with its own 5-year clock running from the marriage itself, independent of the 15-year/25-year residence-based grounds in rw_citizenship_naturalisation.json.
